_comment: Floor passages: a cell that moves whoever stops on it to another map. For the maps that
need a way out and have no element to hang a passage off -- the client only lets a
player click what its own map data has (see teleports.json). Nothing is declared to the
client, so the cell looks like any other: put one only where the map's drawing already
A cell that already has an element's passage keeps that one. Several passages that each ask
for a «criterion» can share a cell: the first that holds leads, these before the graph's. This is a file of its own
and not a list in teleports.json because Jondo Studio's passage editor rewrites that
file whole, with only the passages it knows.
THE GM PRISON'S DUNGEON, 105120002, has no element at all. The cage hanging from its
rope, at the right of the big room, stands on cell 333: stepping into it lifts you to
the island, 105119744, on 342 in front of its chest. The rest of the round is in
«removed» lists the cells whose passage from the 2.73 world graph is left out:
The graph is Dofus 2's, and where a place was rebuilt since its old stairs still fire

removed.why: Travelers' Tower, Prisión: the cell its teleporter is used from. Dofus 2's way down to 130155009 moved whoever went to use it there, and the teleporter's choice arrived on the wrong map.
Travelers' Tower: Dofus 2's way back up to the Prisión, on the same cell as its teleporter's.
Travelers' Tower, Prisión: Dofus 2's stairs to the Sala de información, a room its teleporters join in Dofus 3.
Travelers' Tower, Sala de información: Dofus 2's stairs to the Prisión, a room its teleporters join in Dofus 3.

passages.why: Dyna Mine [10,-19], «Attention à la Bête !»: the slab before the trap's gallery opens its grille once the six baits are laid (4680), and the character hides in the trap room until the creature is down (4673); Dofus pour les noobs: «placez votre personnage sur la dalle pour ouvrir la grille et entrez dans la pièce».

Isle of Moon, Tortuga beach [35,5]: the hole in the wrecked ship's hull (cells 255, 269), which Kar Ybe complains everybody takes for a door; the sand below it (284) lets in. The client has no element there and its graph no passage.

Isle of Moon, path of skulls [32,4]: the wreck's doorway under the hanging frame (244, 258); «Entrez dans l'épave de bateau» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Sur les traces des Moonies»). No element outside and no passage in the client's graph.

The luminous vault of the Gúltar family in the cemetery of the Tortured [-14,36] (Dofus pour les noobs: «placer sur la cellule de gauche juste devant le caveau lumineux»), on Bonta's side of «No dejes que tus hijos vaguen»: down to the crypt where Cabotina's spirit waits, from Hata's report until the family is calmed. Brakmar's side keeps the 2.73 graph's passage on the same cell, to the vault of the remains. INFERRED landing: 456, the crypt's floor by its way up.
The same vault once the family is calmed, for whoever left before Cabotina gave the collar: the crypt at peace. INFERRED landing: 456.

The way up out of the Gúltar crypt: its floor opens at the bottom, between cells 469 and 484, and no element is drawn there. Lands on 314 of the cemetery, where the vault of the remains lets one out too.
The way up out of the crypt at peace, the same opening as 178522112's.

Down the frozen lake's crane [-64,-55]: «Dans les profondeurs du lac gelé, parlez à Waldos» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Les joyeux de la couronne»), «Descendez comme pour aller dans le donjon» («Ejército de las sombras» (L'armée des ombres, Dofus pour les noobs)). The planks' end under the crane, the only way the surface's drawing gives down; no element is drawn on it and the 2.73 graph has no transition into the depths (55836672, 55837184 and 55837696 only lead to one another). Lands at the foot of the depths' winch. INFERRED cells.

Back up the crane from the depths, by the winch on their left edge (the 2.73 graph brings the mine under the same crane up from its cell 448). Lands on the planks next to the way down. INFERRED cells.

The depths' right edge into the cave where Reltux's bag lies: the 2.73 graph's walk from 55836672 to 55837184 leaves on cell 503, and the client's own map data draws no arrow there. Lands by the cave's left wall. INFERRED landing.
And back: the graph's walk from 55837184 to 55836672 leaves on cell 490, the cave's left edge. Lands by the depths' right edge. INFERRED landing.
